atoms.label: I
atoms.proof: 4x-3y-1=c iff y=(4/3)x-(c+1)/3. At c=-1 it is the line y=(4/3)x.

atoms.label: II
atoms.proof: At c=0 it is y=(4/3)x-1/3, a single line, not the union of the axes.

atoms.label: III
atoms.proof: At c=2 it is y=(4/3)x-1, a line rather than a parabola.
